title: Session of Korean Presbyterian Church of Washington v. Korean Capital Presbytery
disposition_detail: The Standing Judicial Commission found the complaint prematurely filed because Presbytery had not completed its action on it.
first_summary: The SJC rejected the Session’s complaint as premature because Korean Capital Presbytery had not completed its action on the complaint.
